user.title: Ajax DoorBell
user.description: Use an ONVIF account created in the Ajax app: Devices → DoorBell → Settings → Service → Connection via ONVIF → ONVIF users. The Operator role is enough.

data_description.host: IP address of the DoorBell on your network. Give it a fixed lease in your router.
data_description.username: Not your Ajax account: the local ONVIF user of the DoorBell.
data_description.port: 8080 unless you changed it in the Ajax app. The RTSP port is read from the DoorBell.

reauth_confirm.title: ONVIF account refused
reauth_confirm.description: The DoorBell at {host} refused the ONVIF account. Enter it again, or create a new one in the Ajax app.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device. Check the address and that ONVIF is enabled in the Ajax app.
error.invalid_auth: The device refused this ONVIF account.
error.no_profiles: The device answers ONVIF but shares no video stream with this account.

abort.already_configured: This DoorBell is already set up.
abort.not_video_device: This Ajax device has no ONVIF service (probably a hub).
abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to another device.

data_description.ring_duration: How long a ring waits for an answer before it counts as missed.
data_description.call_timeout: A call nobody hangs up ends by itself after this time.

invalid_auth.message: The DoorBell refused the ONVIF account.

no_doorbell.message: No loaded Ajax DoorBell matches this target.

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: Marks the call as answered: the ringing stops on every screen.

answered_by.name: Answered by
answered_by.description: Name of the screen or person who answered, shown on the other screens.

event_permission.title: {name}: no access to doorbell events
event_permission.description: The DoorBell shows its video to the ONVIF account but refuses its event subscription, so rings and detections do not reach Home Assistant. In the Ajax app, give this ONVIF user the Operator role (Devices → DoorBell → Settings → Service → Connection via ONVIF → ONVIF users). This message disappears by itself once events flow again.
